newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady to firmer as crude steadies.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady to firmer as crude steadies.

text.p: NWE naphtha was steady to slightly firmer on Wednesday amid steadier crude oil futures although activity was subdued in the wake of Tuesday's sharp fall, traders said.
June swaps were valued at around $189 a tonne cif NWE while July were talked at a 50 cent contango to that. Physical players appeared still to be standing back.
"I think most people are watching the market at the moment," a refinery-based trader said.
